programme.title: S01 : E24 Street Eats Around the World - Griddle Nation
programme.desc: Bustling markets and sizzling sounds inspire a griddled tour of street food. From sweet to savory, each dish captures the rhythm of streets worldwide reflecting the traditions and bold character of flavors everywhere.

programme.title: S02 : E07 Fire & Spice - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Spanish Flare - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: S03 : E07 Brie Larson Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Brie Larson and Courtney McBroom’s cookbook Party People! Follow along as Shahir makes pineapple right-side-up cake, mushroom pâté, and a breakfast taco casserole!

programme.title: S02 : E02 Shrimp and Sausage - A is for Apple
programme.desc: It's all about the letter "S" as Chef Robert Jewell cooks up tasty meals using shrimp and sausage. For his first recipe, Robert fries up turmeric-spiced sweet potato fritters with a shrimp centre. He takes this tantalizing appetizer to another level with a savoury lime soy dipping sauce. Next up, Robert makes an English breakfast strata. This sausage casserole is easily the BEST way to start your day. He layers the bottom of the dish with buttered sourdough slices, before adding crispy fried sausages, leeks and tomatoes. He then covers it in a creamy egg mixture, crumbles stilton on top and bakes it to golden brown. Finally, Robert combines shrimp and sausage into one flavourful dish.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Brassica - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo begins his cruciferous crusade with a hearty bowl of broccoli and cauliflower soup, topped with toasted florets and finished with a hit of spicy black mustard. Then he mixes tender confit kohlrabi with some fresh and saucy kohlrabi to create a salad. Next up is a soba noodle stir fry, combining daikon radish with shiitake, scallions, and sesame. Lastly, chef Pino puts together some fluffy frittata-style muffins packed with tomato and spicy arugula leaves. Bravo brassicas!

programme.title: S01 : E13 Bursts of Japanese Flavours - One World Kitchen

programme.title: S01 : E11 Salmon Salad Niçoise - Up the Dish
programme.desc: How many ways can salmon be prepared? Up the Dish is on a mission to find out! Tiera Singh's Salmon Salad NiÃ§oise is a staple of the French Riviera with shallot, eggs, and haricot verts, but she swaps out the tuna for luxuriant olive oil poached salmon - it may not be traditional but it sure tastes good! Poppy Sandler smokes the competition with a buttery Smoked Salmon Omelette, garnished with fresh chives and earthy goat cheese. Next, Micah Trainor skips the salmon but keeps the veggies for her steamed Tofu Nori Dim Sum Dumplings, with tart gingERS-pickled shallots and tons of green goodness. Missy Hui has the big finish; her Salmon with Béarnaise is cooked sous vide for a precisely cooked fish dish and served alongside Pommes Anna for a plate that's straight out of Paris.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Ireland + Japan - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: S01 : E03 Dumplings - Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui goes back to her childhood with Chicken and Dumplings - comfort food for every age! The chicken-dumpling journey doesn't end there; Micah Trainor turns the dish upside down and inside out with her Chinese-inspired Chicken-Chive Gyoza, a crunchy-crispy dim sum delight, with an ovERS-the-top chili sauce! How does Poppy Sandler spice things up? Herb Gnudi with Red Pepper Sauce, a spicy-savoury dumpling that's coated in nutty brown butter and creamy ricotta cheese for extra oomph. Tiera Singh finishes with another European dish - Spinach Spaetzle and Crispy Prosciutto, straight from Germany! Chewy spaetzle, fresh spinach, crispy ham - this textural treat doesn't let up!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Fire & Spice - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies and a blend of fresh hot peppers.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Spanish Flare - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It - Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.desc: Satisfy your craving for something sweet with these delicious sablefish and lobster dishes from chef and seafood lover Spencer Watts.

programme.desc: Host Desiree Nielsen serves up delicious meals for a busy lifestyle from a mouth-watering breakfast burrito to a no-carb cauliflower pizza.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Low Carbs, No Problems - The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Host Desiree Nielsen shows us low-carb options for any meal of the day. Buckwheat pancakes smothered in blueberries? Yes, please!

programme.title: S03 : E07 Brie Larson Part 1 - Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Brie Larson and Courtney McBroom’s cookbook Party People! Follow along as Shahir makes pineapple right-side-up cake, mushroom pâté, and a breakfast taco casserole!

programme.title: S01 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Rice Balls Stuffed with Seafood and Pistachio Cannoli are on the menu as Chef Michael Bonacini explores dishes from the Italian island of Sicily.

programme.title: S02 : E19 Duck Wing Delight & Rum Coolers - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are serving up a BBQ menu packed with bold spices, sweet flavours, and creative combinations. They sear blackened scallops with avocado corn relish, glaze duck wings with raspberry chipotle sauce, pair them with smashed potatoes and mushrooms, and cool down with honeyed watermelon salad and a rum cooler.

programme.title: S02 : E20 Italian Brussels Sprouts & Hickory Turkey Legs - Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are taking BBQ comfort food to the next level with smoky favourites and sweet surprises. They grill Brussels sprouts with pancetta, truffle, and parmesan, smoke hickory turkey legs with a sweet and spicy black bean salad, and finish with grilled fruit treats.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Lettuce Eat Lasagna - The Urban Vegetarian
programme.desc: Desiree Nielsen shows how salads can be a tasty main AND served warm with a grilled romaine salad.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Apples and Anchovies - A is for Apple
programme.desc: In an "A" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas makes apple fritters and fried anchovies. But how will she combine these distinct flavours in the same dish?

programme.title: S01 : E09 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: S01 : E28 Cashews and Carrots - A is for Apple
programme.desc: Chef Lauren Gulyas tests her imagination with cashews and carrots. First, she makes cashew chicken and carrot cupcakes. But how will she combine them?

programme.title: S01 : E03 Salty - Fish the Dish
programme.desc: Meaty prawns and melt-in-your-mouth cod are on the menu as trendy chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts gets a little "salty" with seafood.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Cassoulet - Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Carrot Cake - Up the Dish
programme.desc: Who said dessert couldn't come before dinner? In this episode of Up the Dish, host Missy Hui serves up a hedonistically hard-to-beat Carrot Cake, made extra-moist with applesauce and tons of cream cheese icing. Micah Trainor ditches dessert and heads for the healthy option - a Cider Poached Chicken Waldorf Salad full of pecans and cinnamon for that classic cake flavour. Poppy Sandler innovates with Indian inspiration - carrot cake becomes Carrot Rostis, thin pancakes dished out with perfectly poached eggs and a homemade savoury raisin jam. Tiera Singh returns to the Rock and makes Jerk Crab Salad Mango Rolls. Jazzing up the crab meat with a blend of Jamaican jerk and autumn spices, she finishes the dish by wrapping the mixture in layers of smooth avocado slices and juicy mango.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Basilicata - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

programme.title: S02 : E04 Tuscany - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: The popular region of Tuscany is known for its wines, cheeses, and gorgeous sights. Chef Michael Bonacini introduces us to Tuscany's fine cuisine with four of his favourite dishes. Michael draws attention to the importance of mushrooms in Tuscan culture with an antipasto: Many Mushroom soup. Warm, hearty, and full of earthy flavour, Michael tops this soup with fried sage leaves to combine comfort and crunch in a single bite. For his primo, Michael explores a Tuscan favourite - Lamb Ragu! Served over pici noodles, Michael's rich ragu is complemented by fresh, light herbs. Then, Michael serves up a Porchetta-Style Duck, a crispy and tender secondo. To bring his meal together, Michael ends with a smooth and decadent Creamy Coffee Custard any coffee fan will appreciate.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Veneto - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: From hearty inland crops to fresh food of the sea, the Venetian region covers it all. Host Michael Bonacini begins with the sea as he serves up an antipasto of succulent Soft Shell Crab. Michael pairs the crab with a Tangy Aioli made from sundried tomatoes, creating the perfect combination of crispy and creamy. Moving inland for his primo, Michael twists together two classic Venetian dishes to make a new favourite: Radicchio Risotto! With his secondo, Michael cooks up a light and creamy Pancetta-Wrapper Snapper with Pea Mash. Sweet and tender, this dish will melt in your mouth. Whether you're in the mood to share or feeling a little selfish, Michael's Giant Almond Crumb Biscuit covers it all. Buttery, sweet, and satisfyingly crumbly, this biscuit is sure to lead to a memorable dinner!

programme.title: S02 : E06 Puglia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Chef Michael Bonacini explores its native ingredients through some of Puglia's favourite meals. First up, Michael's antipasto is a guaranteed crunchy bite with crispy Fried Mussels. Stepping away from the sea, Michael highlights Puglia's prize crop: tomatoes! Combining colourful tomatoes with flavourful burrata cheese, Michael cooks up comfort in a bowl with his Tomato and Burrata Risotto. Taking on a more festive flair, Michael introduces us to Little Pork Bombs, the hottest street food in Puglia. With a filling of fresh herbs and melted cheese, these pork skewers are savoury and irresistible. Then, Michael introduces a classic Father's Day dessert for his dulce: Sour Cherry-on-Top Fritters. A dessert for strolling the street, Michal's crispy golden fritters topped with light mascarpone whipped cream will have you whipping them up at home as well!

programme.title: S02 : E07 Sicily - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Lazio - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Filled with ruins in its bustling streets, the region of Lazio sticks with grandeur in all it does, including food! To introduce us to Lazio, Host Michael Bonacini highlights its Jewish influence with a crispy Roman Jewish-style Artichokes. As crunchy as a potato chip, Michael's artichokes are a delicious fried treat that are a perfect way to kick off a delicious meal. For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Cooked with a blend of vegetables and sauce, Michael's Braised Oxtail brings forth the history of cuisine. Returning to Rome for his final dish, Michael cooks up the popular Sour Cherry and Ricotta Tart. With the tart cherries countered by the creamy ricotta, every decadent bite offers a world of taste.

programme.title: S02 : E09 Campania - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Campania's beautiful coastline is filled with two things: tourists and seafood. Diving into the culture of the region, Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini begins his meal with a salad from the Island of Capri. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.

programme.title: S02 : E10 Emilia Romagna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: S02 : E11 Calabria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: S02 : E12 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: S02 : E13 Umbria - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: S02 : E14 Sardegna - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: S02 : E15 Friuli Venezia Guilia - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Trentino-Alto Adige - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Basilicata - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: S02 : E02 Molise - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini highlights the tiny region of Molise, exposing some of its best kept savoury secrets. Starting with a classic, Michael cooks up a delicious multi-layered Chicory Timbale, a pie filled with fresh chicory, ripe roma tomatoes, and sliced prosciutto. To crisp up the top of the pie, Michael tops his delicious dish with finely grated pecorino cheese and crunchy breadcrumbs. Next up, Michael's primo is a spicy Octopus in Purgatory. This tender, colourful, and sumptuous dish is sure to impress in both looks and taste! For his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional Marinated Rabbit. Stewed in wine, tomatoes, and chilies, this rustic dish will have your guests asking for seconds. To finish, Michael whips up light and luscious Peaches and Cream Cookies. Filled with decadent cream, these round delights are refreshing and lighter-than-air - the perfect way to end a wholesome meal.

programme.title: S02 : E03 Valle D'Aosta - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Delving into the cold mountainous region of Valle D'Aosta, Celebrity chef Michael Bonacini whips up a meal of four hearty dishes that are sure to warm up any chilly day. First up is Michael's antipasto of Wild Mushrooms and Lardo on Rye. Coated with rich, earthy mushrooms, buttery fontina cheese, and savoury cured pork, this decadent dish highlights a combination of iconic flavours from Valle D'Aosta. Next up is a twist on traditional pasta with Valle D'Aosta's unique Chestnut Fettucine topped with Sweet Pork and Earthy Cabbage. The secret to this dish? Chestnut flour to create a denser, sweeter, and nuttier pasta. For his secondo, Michael turns to the pride of the region, Fontina cheese, to fill his Stuffed Veal Cutlets. Luscious and rich, this dish is a burst of luxurious flavours in every bite. For his final dish, Michael shows his sweet side with a Crema di Cogne served with Valdostana Tile Cookies. The thin, crispy cookies with a hint of hazelnut dipped in a light chocolate cream are the perfect way to wrap up Michael's luxurious Valle D'Aosta meal.

Concerto - OSN Fabio Luisi e Alexander Gadjiev Torino 2022
programme.sub-title: Concerto - OSN Fabio Luisi e Alexander Gadjiev Torino 2022
programme.desc: On April 28, 2022, esteemed conductor Fabio Luisi and acclaimed pianist Alexander Gadjiev took the stage at the Auditorium Rai "Arturo Toscanini" in Turin, accompanied by the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai. Gadjiev delivered a masterful performance of Chopin’s Piano Concerto No. 2, while Luisi led a captivating interpretation of Strauss’ "Aus Italien".

programme.title: Rhythms of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The beats of the Mediterranean tell a story of culture, energy, and innovation. Malta’s Mużika Mużika celebrates local talent, Italy’s Nameless Festival electrifies the coast with indie and electronic sounds, Spain rocks out at Azkena Rock Festival, and Turkey swings with jazz at the Istanbul Caz Festival. Feel the pulse that moves the region.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Tuscany
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Tuscany, one of Italy’s most picturesque and beloved regions. From rolling vineyards and medieval hill towns to art-filled cities, she discovers the essence of la dolce vita. Malini enjoys local wine tastings, traditional Tuscan dishes, and breathtaking landscapes, capturing the timeless charm and warmth that make Tuscany truly unforgettable.

programme.title: S01:E06 Outdoor and Nature Ep 6 - Outdoor and Nature
programme.desc: OUTDOOR & Nature, a weekly program that highlights sports, outdoor activities, and the breathtaking scenery of Cyprus, will introduce you to the great outdoors. Each episode highlights government initiatives, community organisations, and volunteer efforts to preserve Cyprus's natural heritage while examining nature, wildlife, and conservation. Take a trip of inspiration, exploration, and adventure with hosts Panicos Pilalis and Aristo Aristeidou. Listen and get motivated to go on your own outdoor adventure in Cyprus!

programme.title: S01:E06 Dalmatian Brunch Ep 6 - Brač (Supetar)
programme.desc: On Brač, famed for its white stone, Zlatni Rat beach, and Vidova Gora, we stopped in Supetar to taste tradition. Restaurateur Teo Dragičević served us šporka juha, mišanca, and vitalac—authentic island flavors rooted in Brač’s rich culinary heritage.

programme.title: S05:E03 Barcelona and Catalunya - Rick Steves Europe
programme.desc: Join Rick as he roams the lively streets of Barcelona, savoring its artistic treasures and flavorful tapas, before venturing to nearby landmarks in the proudly distinct region of Catalunya.

programme.title: Concerto - OSN Fabio Luisi e Alexander Gadjiev Torino 2022
programme.sub-title: Concerto - OSN Fabio Luisi e Alexander Gadjiev Torino 2022
programme.desc: On April 28, 2022, esteemed conductor Fabio Luisi and acclaimed pianist Alexander Gadjiev took the stage at the Auditorium Rai "Arturo Toscanini" in Turin, accompanied by the Orchestra Sinfonica Nazionale della Rai. Gadjiev delivered a masterful performance of Chopin’s Piano Concerto No. 2, while Luisi led a captivating interpretation of Strauss’ "Aus Italien".

programme.title: Mediterranean Festivals
programme.desc: From classical opera to electronic beats, the Mediterranean showcases its finest cultural experiences. Italy’s Puccini Festival brings timeless melodies to Tuscan venues, Malta’s Isle of MTV and Glitch Festival offer modern music spectacles, Spain’s Pirineos Sur Festival celebrates world music in mountain landscapes, and Greece’s Supa Dupa Fly Festival blends urban culture, music, and street art in a festival like no other.

programme.title: Mediterranean Yoga Start Your Day Gently
programme.sub-title: Mediterranean Yoga Start Your Day Gently
programme.desc: Mediterranean Yoga is a series that blends Embodiment Yoga with the peaceful beauty of the Mediterranean. Set in stunning coastal and natural locations, each episode encourages viewers to reconnect mind and body through gentle movement, breathwork, and mindfulness in a safe and calming space.

programme.title: Memoirs September 16
programme.desc: Memoirs September 16

programme.title: Whats On Waves and Rhythms
programme.desc: From seaside beats to floating stages, this episode captures Mediterranean music by the water. Malta Boomerang Festival and Earth Garden celebrate eco conscious music and arts, while Spain Bilbao BBK fuses urban culture with live performances. Set sail on the Mediterranea Metal Cruise, a unique floating festival, and enjoy Malta iconic Jazz Festival with historic and coastal backdrops. The Mediterranean truly comes alive where music meets the waves.

programme.title: Med Minds 05 Plato
programme.desc: Plato, the philosopher of Athens, questioned life, truth, and society, leaving ideas that still shape the world.

programme.title: Med Nations 10 Malta
programme.desc: Malta, a small island nation with a big Mediterranean story. From the historic streets of Valletta to sun-soaked beaches and ancient temples, Malta reveals a vibrant blend of history, culture, and coastal life shaped by centuries of Mediterranean influence.

programme.title: Med Destinations Lake Bled
programme.desc: Step into the fairytale beauty of Lake Bled, Slovenia, on Med Destinations. Crystal-clear waters, a picturesque island church, and lush Alpine surroundings make it a serene Mediterranean escape.

programme.title: Med Destinations Pula
programme.desc: Discover Pula, Croatia, with Med Destinations. Famous for its Roman amphitheater and charming old town, Pula combines historical grandeur with Adriatic seaside beauty.

programme.title: S01:E05 Gold Cuisine EP 5 - Gold Cuisine
programme.desc: The spotlight falls on two traditional Cypriot favorites. First, we explore the art of preparing Oven Lamb Kleftiko, a slow-cooked dish where tender lamb is infused with herbs and baked to perfection, capturing the essence of village cooking. Then, the journey continues with Kattimeria, fried sweet flatbreads that balance crisp texture with a hint of indulgent sweetness. Together, these recipes showcase the comforting richness and variety of Cyprus’s culinary heritage.

programme.title: Med Destinations Rimini
programme.desc: Med Destinations visits Rimini, Italy’s seaside gem, where golden beaches meet rich history. From Roman ruins to vibrant nightlife, Rimini offers the perfect mix of culture and coastal charm.

programme.title: Into the Med Gozo Island of Traditions
programme.sub-title: Into the Med Gozo Island of Traditions
programme.desc: Born on the sunny island of Gozo, Susannah always had a connection to the Mediterranean. After moving to the Netherlands as a child, she is returning to the Mediterranean to rediscover her roots. Starting with the raw beauty of her home island, she invites you to explore the Mediterranean through a lens of discovery and belonging.

programme.title: S01:E08 Dalmatian Brunch Ep 8 - Kaštela (U masliniku)
programme.desc: In Kaštela, a cluster of seven towns near Split, winemaking runs deep. Among olive groves and vineyards, Mladen Kuzmanić treated us to local flavors—sipa i bob, pancetta, goat cheese, and homemade sausage—perfectly paired with a glass of regional wine.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Casablanca
programme.desc: A lot of people say Casablanca isn’t worth visiting and that you should head straight to Marrakesh or Fez — but Malini Angelica completely disagrees! In this video, she explores Morocco’s most authentic city and discovers where Europe meets Africa in a fascinating blend of culture, history, and architecture. It’s not overrun with tourists, it’s 100% real, and it ended up being her favorite city in Morocco!

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea

También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S8:E5 Se graba un éxito - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En el quinto capítulo de la temporada, las hermanas Jiménez están en Madrid dispuestas a grabar su propio videoclip, pero no todo será un camino de rosas para ellas.

programme.title: S8:E6 ¡Nos vamos a México! - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En esta sexta entrega, Iván y Jose van a sorprender a toda la familia Jiménez con su nuevo concepto de negocio. Dani que anímicamente está pasando un mal momento, decide organizar un viaje en familia siguiendo el consejo de un amigo.

programme.title: S8:E7 Entre México y Granada - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En el penúltimo capítulo de esta temporada, los Jiménez empiezan a vivir su propia aventura mexicana, con grandes momentos y sorpresas para toda la familia. En Granada, Reyes recibe emocionada los modelos para la presentación de su hija.

programme.title: S8:E8 Queda magia para rato - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En el último capítulo de la temporada, los Jiménez, que continúan sus aventuras en México cierran su viaje a lo grande. Rebe, Susi y Graciela se despiden del país con una gran sorpresa para el resto de la familia.

programme.title: S9:E1 ¡Vuelven los Gipsy Kings! - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Dejamos a los Jiménez en México, donde Dani tenía una misión clara: unir a la familia. De vuelta a casa, toca comprobar si lo ha conseguido porque las novedades no tardan en aparecer.

programme.title: S9:E2 Nuevos comienzos, viejas raíces - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En este segundo programa conocemos a la nueva Raquel, más conectada que nunca con Dios y decidida a iniciar una etapa diferente en su vida. Mientras tanto, Noemí abre las puertas de su casa con un house tour muy esperado que mostrará su día a día como gitana de urba.

programme.title: S9:E3 La llegada de Juan a Plasencia, un bautizo y rumores de boda - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En el tercer programa los Jiménez regresan a Plasencia con un objetivo muy especial para Juan: conocer la ciudad donde se crio Graciela. El viaje también sirve para descubrir el nuevo hogar de Susi e Iván, han transformado por completo el antiguo garaje para convertirlo en el “Susipiso”.

programme.title: S9:E4 Si hay fiesta, hay churros - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Rebe recibe una propuesta inesperada: ser jueza del certamen de Miss Gitana. Y no es la única alegría: Graciela, la menor de los Jiménez, anuncia su boda. Mientras, las Salazar organizan una fiesta inolvidable y siguen adelante con su proyecto de churrería, la calma dura poco.

programme.title: S9:E5 Se vienen curvas... - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Volvemos a Plasencia tras el paso triunfal de las tres hermanas como jurado en Miss Gitana para hacer un comunicado oficial: la boda de Graciela se retrasa (el amor sigue, tranquilos). Raquel avanza con su proyecto y toca hacer camisetas. ¿Aprobamos Brilli-Churros?

programme.title: S9:E6 Un mensaje desolador y el negocio de los 'brilli-churros' - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: En la casa de los Jiménez, Marisol continúa con los preparativos de la boda de su hija Graciela con su yerno Juan. La alegría durará poco en Plasencia tras el mensaje que reciben La Rebe y Susi de su hermana menor.

programme.title: S0:E1 Nueva miembro en la familia - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La Rebe da una gran noticia a toda su familia: está embarazada. Los Reyes del Mercadillo tratan de asimilar esta nueva situación y llevarla de la mejor manera posible. Después de superar el shock inicial, sus padres, Dani y Marisol, sus tíos y sus primas arropan y aconsejan a la joven

programme.title: S0:E2 Todo listo para el bebé - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Redecorar la vida, recuperar los recuerdos de juventud, preparar la llegada del bebé, y sobre todo, responder la gran pregunta: ¿niño o niña? Los trabajos se les acumulan a los Reyes del Mercadillo. Esta entrega culmina con una visita al hospital… ¿nacerá antes de tiempo?

programme.title: S0:E3 El nacimiento del retoño - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Fue bonito mientras duró, pero los embarazos es lo que tienen, llegan a su fin: La Rebe va a tener a su bebé no sin antes liar a los suyos con sus últimos antojos/caprichos, incluido un espectacular baby shower a cargo de las Salazar, sus amigas del alma. Además, acudiremos al nacimiento del retoño

programme.title: S0:E4 Comieza la cuenta atrás - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La cuenta atrás para la boda del año ha comenzado aunque no lo sepan ni los propios protagonistas de la misma. Pero es que no hay nada como cruzarse con "Las Amiras", unas singulares y coloridas wedding planner, para despertar deseos dormidos.

programme.title: S0:E5 De bombazo en bombazo - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Jimenez no ganan para sustos. A la noticia de la boda express de la Rebe, se une ahora la despedida de soltera, la presentación oficial del novio de la Susi y el esperado cara a cara entre Dani y José.

programme.title: S0:E6 Felices para siempre - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Llegó el gran día. Todo está listo para la celebración de la boda de Rebe y José, y un día tan esperado no podía estar falto de alegría, momentos emotivos y alguna que otra sorpresa. ¡Que comience la fiesta!

programme.title: S1:E1 Los Chunguitos - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Mientras Los Chunguitos aprovechan una barbacoa familiar en la casa de su mánager para empezar el año de celebración de su 40º aniversario en la música, en Palma de Mallorca los Fernández esperan la llegada de 'El Charro', el patriarca de la familia encargado de poner orden en la casa de los líos.

programme.title: S1:E2 Descanso en Torremolinos - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: José y Juan Salazar se van de vacaciones a Torremolinos. Allí, son confundidos con Los Chichos y, para relajar tensiones, disfrutan de una divertida noche de bingo.

programme.title: S1:E3 En busca de las Chunguitas - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Chunguitos vuelven a Madrid para buscar a dos nuevas coristas, ‘las Chunguitas’, que los acompañarán en su gira de aniversario. Al mismo tiempo, la esposa de Juan le prepara una fiesta sorpresa por su 60º cumpleaños a la que acudirá la familia Salazar al completo.

programme.title: S1:E4 Los Chunguitos aprender ingles - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Chunguitos y sus nuevas coristas, ‘Las Chunguitas’, viajan hasta La Rioja para dar el último concierto antes del ansiado viaje a Nueva York; Joaquín Fernández ya tiene la mente puesta en su viaje a la República Dominicana.

programme.title: S1:E5 El cumpleaños de la Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Chunguitos, las ‘Chunguitas’ y el equipo de músicos ponen rumbo a la provincia de La Rioja, donde darán el último concierto antes del viaje a Nueva York. ¿Cómo acogerá la Gran Manzana a los Salazar? Los Fernández se encuentran un tanto divididos.

programme.title: S1:E6 Nueva York - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Tras haber visitado la Gran Manzana de día, Los Chunguitos vivirán la experiencia de recorrer la noche neoyorkina en limusina. Será el anticipo perfecto para el día más feliz de José, ese en el que cumplirá su sueño de bautizarse por el rito evangélico.

programme.title: S2:E7 Las nuevas dinastías - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Fueron toda una revelación en su primera temporada. Ahora vuelven con más fuerza, con nuevos retos y mucho más humor. Dos nuevas dinastías, los Gonzalez y los Montoya; dos veteranas, los Fernandez Navarro y los Jimenez; y la irrupción con fuerza de Noemí y su familia, los Salazar.

programme.title: S2:E8 Misses y reconquistas - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández vivirán su propia y particular reconquista: la de Kiki y ‘la Gordita’. El joven enamorado necesita una prodigiosa idea para que la ‘Operación pancarta’ no pase desapercibida.

programme.title: S2:E9 ¿Volverá 'La Gordita' con Kiki? - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández siguen intentando convencer a 'La Gordita' para que vuelva a los brazos de Kiki, mientras que la Rebe, la pequeña de los Jiménez y una de las aspirantes para coronarse como miss gitana, inicia su particular camino a la perfección, asistiendo a unas clases preparatorias.

programme.title: S2:E10 A viajar se ha dicho - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Después de la reconciliación de Kiki y ‘La Gordita’, los Fernández-Navarro cambiarán su habitual lugar de residencia, Mallorca, para trasladarse hasta Badajoz, donde les espera un evento familiar. El viaje, cómo no, va a convertirse en una total odisea.

programme.title: S2:E11 Miss Gitana España - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Jiménez se preparan para disfrutar, al fin, de una de las citas más importantes de sus vidas: el certamen de Miss Gitana España. Con la Rebe ya en Madrid preparándose para el concurso, el resto de la familia llegará justo a tiempo para verla desfilar por la pasarela.

programme.title: S2:E12 Llega la operación bikini - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Tras la emocionante jornada de la coronación como Miss España Gitana, los acontecimientos se precipitan en casa de los Jiménez: los reyes del mercadillo están a punto de debutar en el mundo de la publicidad.

programme.title: S2:E13 Milán espera a la Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La flamante Miss España Gitana, la Rebe, sigue atendiendo sus compromisos profesionales que le llevan hasta Milán para realizar una sesión de fotos profesional.

programme.title: S2:E14 Fin del camino - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Ha llegado por fin la gran cita de los Salazar, el bautizo de Mini Noemí. Un gran castillo como salón de banquetes, unos trajes de lujo y unos invitados de excepción, entre los que están La Rebe, flamante Miss España Gitana y los Jiménez, que vienen con un imponente regalo.

programme.title: S3:E15 ¡Qué comience el "Juego de Troníos"! - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández Navarro, los Jiménez, los Montoya y los Salazar vuelven dispuestos para revalidar su trono catódico con todas las armas a su alcance. Humor, amor y mucha diversión.

programme.title: S3:E16 La confesión de la rebe y aventuras en Tailandia - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández ultiman su viaje alrededor del mundo, La Rebe se prepara para confesar que tiene novio, Los Montoya ponen en marcha la nueva tienda de Saray y Las Salazar están centradas en el desfile del Orgullo Gay.

programme.title: S3:E17 Tormenta en casa de La Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Las vidas de los Jiménez en Plasencia darán un vuelco radical. La de Rebe por haber tenido que confesar su nueva relación; la de Dani y Marisol por el proceso de asumir la noticia.

programme.title: S3:E18 El amago de pedida de La Rebe y el "Cristo de todas las broncas" - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La aventura de los Fernández-Navarro en Tailandia se alargará con un eterno viaje en tren hacia Chiang Mai. En Palma de Mallorca, José y Fali no sabrán qué hacer para disfrutar de la vida a costa de Joaquín e involucrar a Kiki en sus andanzas.

programme.title: S3:E19 Memorias de África, la familia Fernández en Kenia - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: José y Fali deciden llevar a Joaquín y a los aventureros de la familia Fernánez a nuevo destino: Kenia. Los Jiménez viven una trumática experiencia en la ecoaldea gallega.

programme.title: S3:E20 Olimpiadas gitanas en África - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La cita deportiva del año en pleno Masai-Mara, los trucos de "todo a un euro" contra la alopecia y poesías para llegar al corazón de la amada.

programme.title: S3:E21 En busca del amor - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los reyes del Sacromonte regresan al programa en vísperas del inminente estreno de su espectáculo flamenco. Además, Cristo busca el amor y la desaparición de Naiara por fin se esclarecerá.

programme.title: S3:E22 La gran boda - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Decidirse a hacerse un injerto o no decidirse a seguir con el novio. Entre estas dudas trascendentales, un gran evento: la madre de todas las bodas, la de Naiara y su novio.

programme.title: S3:E23 Chapuzas a domicilio, "brilli-brilli" y la "Second Date" de Cristo - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Una novia arrepentida, un viaje con un destino de ensueño, una propuesta profesional que no se puede rechazar y una second date que pone de los nervios a Cristo.

programme.title: S3:E24 Un adiós con trasiego de maletas - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: El día de la despedida ha llegado. "Los Gipsy Kings" se despiden con maletas de viaje y con la satisfacción de haber cumplido casi todos los sueños que se propusieron cuando empezaron.

programme.title: S4:E25 Montando el Cristo - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Vuelven Los Salazar, los Fernández Navarro y los Jiménez junto a dos nuevas incorporaciones: Cristo y la familia Contreras desde Sevilla; y las Muñoz, un matriarcado de los que “quita el sentío”, desde el Rastro madrileño

programme.title: S4:E26 Flores para La Rebe y un viaje a San Francisco - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Con mucha magia, encanto y algún que otro ardid, 'Los Gipsy Kings' viven un torbellino de emociones. En la nueva entrega las cuatro familias tiene que lidiar con nuevos retos profesionales, amores complicados y mentiras piadosas sin perder en ningún momento su sentido del humor.

programme.title: S4:E27 Sentimientos al desnudo - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Mientras Los Jiménez siguen ocupados con las fotos de un catálogo, Dani recibe el chivatazo de que La Rebe está viéndose con un chico. Marisol y Dani unen entonces fuerzas para descubrir si los rumores del enamoramiento de su niña son verdad

programme.title: S4:E28 Las Salazar a la caza de las Kardashian - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La continua batalla de 'Los Gipsy Kings' por cumplir sus sueños comienza a dar sus frutos. Reciben sorprendentes propuestas que les animan a seguir luchando por ellos, todos con su característico sello gipsy

programme.title: S4:E29 Tocata y fuga de la Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Entre amores, mentirijillas y nuevos proyectos, ‘Los Gipsy Kings’ continúan persiguiendo sus metas. En esta nueva entrega, nace un nuevo género musical, hay propuestas muy jugosas y dos acontecimientos: la confesión de Las Salazar y un tsunami familiar que arrolla a los Reyes del Mercadillo

programme.title: S4:E30 El retorno de La Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Joaquín graba el videoclip de su temazo, viajará hasta Japón para promocionarse como cantante revelación y al fin conoceremos a las Muñoz. Rebe regresa de su huida clandestina y volverá con noticias que afectarán a toda la familia

programme.title: S4:E31 Reformas a gogó - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Convertidas en heroínas del bricolage, las Salazar continúan con las ambiciosas reformas en casa buscando los muebles perfectos sin descanso. Por su parte, Toby, la mascota de la familia, tiene un encuentro con sus pretendientas al más puro estilo viceverso.

programme.title: S4:E32 El Gipsyton - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Marisol, matriarca de los Jiménez, está deseando triunfar en el mundo del modelaje. Su primer debut como profesional tiene lugar cuando es escogida como imagen de una peluquería.

programme.title: S4:E33 Luna de miel de La Rebe - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: La Rebe y El José se van de viaje de novios, y toda la familia de esta acompaña a la pareja en la aventura. Los Fernández-Navarro siguen en Japón integrándose en su cultura, empezando por realizar un simulacro de terremotos.

programme.title: S4:E34 Noticia bomba - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Despedida por todo lo alto de la cuarta temporada. Una inauguración caótica, una actuación sin precedentes y un vestido conflictivo serán algunos de los acontecimientos más destacados de esta última entrega, que tendrá como broche final la noticia bomba que estallará en casa de La Rebe

programme.title: S5:E35 El regreso de Los Gipsy Kings - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Después de los especiales navideños, los Jiménez, las Salazar y los Fernández-Navarro arrancan una nueva temporada cargada de aventuras en las que también estarán acompañados por unos viejos conocidos, los Maya.

programme.title: S5:E36 Obodece a Rappel - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández Navarro han decidido dejar su carrera en la música para buscar sus orígenes como les sugirió Rappel. Los Jiménez están encantados con la vuelta de La Rebe y su retoño, pero a la joven le pasa algo y nadie sabe qué puede ser.

programme.title: S5:E37 Con la brilli furgo a punto hasta Marruecos - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Con la ‘brilli-furgo’ tuneada a su gusto, Las Salazar emprenden la búsqueda de maravillosas telas para su negocio de moda y se embarcan en una aventura que las lleva hasta Marruecos. Los Maya disfrutarán de un día de playa.

programme.title: S5:E38 Las Salazar a Marruecos: De la brilli-furgo al camello - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Las aventuras de las Salazar en Marruecos; el nacimiento de la hija de Fali y el regreso del Charro al clan Fernández Navarro; nuevos datos sobre la situación sentimental de La Rebe; y los avances de los Maya en el mundo del golf marbellí.

programme.title: S5:E39 From Vallecas to the World - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Tras la emocionante jornada de modelaje de Noemí en Marruecos, las Salazar recibirán la visita del auténtico y genuino tío John, que les propondrá nada menos que asistir a una boda en Bali, una oportunidad única para buscar los tejidos más exclusivos para su brilli-negocio

programme.title: S5:E40 Las Salazar llegan a Bali en busca de brilli-telas - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Las Salazar llegan a Bali y emprenden la búsqueda de 'brilli-telas' para su negocio. El lugar es un paraíso, se sienten como peces en el agua, pero el choque de culturas con los ‘peces’ de la zona complicará las cosas.

programme.title: S5:E41 Joaquín, tu también flotarás - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Involucrados en el reto de Mariano, los Fernández Navarro acudirán a un túnel de viento en Madrid para, literalmente, volar. Los Fernández Navarro comprobarán la sensación que se siente estando por los aires

programme.title: S5:E42 La Rebe confiesa toda la verdad sobre su relación - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Jiménez viajan a Madrid para que Marisol se informe sobre su soñada operación de estómago. ‘La Rebe’ confiesa la nueva realidad de su vida matrimonial. En Bali, las Salazar descubren que las bodas balinesas no son como esperaban.

programme.title: S5:E43 Marisol vuelve a ser modelo - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Dani recurre a su hermano Angelete para que su mujer se olvide de perder peso con una operación. Para ello, trazan un plan que pasa porque Marisol protagonice otra campaña como modelo.

programme.title: S5:E44 En busca de los orígenes del pueblo gitano - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Tras el sueño revelador de Joaquín, los Fernández Navarro emprenden un viaje con el fin de encontrar el origen del pueblo gitano. Por su parte, Marisol sigue adelante con su nuevo proyecto como modelo y las Salazar ya tienen todo preparado para la gran boda balinesa de Raquel y Carlos.

programme.title: S5:E45 La gran aventura epigpcia de los Fernández Navarro - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Seremos testigos de la aventura de los Fernández Navarro en Egipto, la llegada del bautizo del hijo de la Rebe (con vestidazo de la madre incluido), las bodas de oro de los Maya y la consolidación familiar y empresarial de las Salazar… ¡Que se van a reencontrar con su hija!

programme.title: S5:E46 La reconciliación de Las Salazar - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Fernández Navarro sigue haciendo el Indiana Jones en las pirámides de Egipto. Además, el programa aborda la 'infidelidad' de Noemí a su Raquel en el clan de los Salazar, el noviete de la nieta de Salvadora en la familia Maya, y los preparativos del bautizo del hijo de La Rebe

programme.title: S5:E47 Bautizo, "meollo" brilli- tienda y bodas de oro - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Final de la temporada. ¿Conseguirá descubrir Joaquín en qué consiste el verdadero ‘meollo’ de su origen? ¿Cuál será la celebración más deslumbrante, las bodas de oro de Salvadora o el bautizo del hijo de la Rebe? Y las Salazar, ¿tendrán el éxito esperado con su brilli-tienda?

programme.title: S7:E65 Despedida por todo lo alto - Gipsy Kings
programme.desc: Los Gipsy Kings' nos dicen adiós y lo hacen para siempre con la participación de todos los miembros gitanos y sorpresas insuperables en este último capítulo.

De origen burgués pero no aristocrático, fue invitada a una fiesta a la que dudó si asistir pero, finalmente, decidió acudir y allí conoció al Príncipe.

programme.title: S1:E9 Machu Picchu, San Petersburgo, Cancún - El mundo es tuyo

Nuestro segundo destino es San Petersburgo, la capital histórica de Rusia, donde visitaremos el Museo del Ermitage y degustaremos su gastronomía.

programme.title: S1:E10 Vietnam, Londres, Los Ángeles - El mundo es tuyo

Luego iremos a Londres, en los famosos autobuses rojos, para ver el Big Ben y degustar su “fish & chips” de la calle.
